description: Light canvas; grey rounded box upper-centre with serif text 'Q. What would happen if the Moon were replaced with an equivalently-massed black hole? And what would a lunar ('holar'?) eclipse look like? -Matt'; black-ink stick figure lower-left holding a paper; empty black-outline whiteboard rectangle right.
One-frame pop-on: grey cratered moon drawing appears on the empty whiteboard with label 'M_moon' beneath it.
Same question card and figure; whiteboard shows one cratered moon with label 'M_moon' below.
Over 3 frames a faint ghosted trail of progressively smaller moon outlines extends right from the moon to a tiny black dot; a second label 'M_moon' appears under the dot.
Whiteboard: cratered moon at left with 'M_moon', ghosted trail of shrinking circles ending in a small black dot at right with second 'M_moon'.
Whiteboard interior becomes black with two glowing sun-like coronas: left a black disc labelled 'LUNAR ECLIPSE', right a white disc with tiny dot labelled '???'. Question card and figure unchanged.
Black board panel: black disc with white spiked corona 'LUNAR ECLIPSE' left; bright white disc with corona and tiny centre dot '???' right.
Board returns to white and shows hand-lettered '0.001°F' centred; question card and figure persist.
White board with '0.001°F' centred; question card top; stick figure lower-left.

Hard cut to red full-frame title card: black dinosaur-on-satellite illustration above white 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'; the dinosaur illustration changes pose across tiles f392-f430 (drawn animation); by the last frame (f440 tile) canvas is white with 'BLACK HOLE MOON' and a tiny dot. Exact frame of final cut UNRESOLVED within 49 frames.
White canvas; 'BLACK HOLE MOON' two-line caps upper-centre; one tiny black dot below it.
One-frame pop-on of label 'EVENT HORIZON' with curved arrow pointing up to the tiny dot.
'BLACK HOLE MOON' title; tiny dot; 'EVENT HORIZON' label with curved arrow.
One-frame pop-on at right: label 'SAND' plus a line-drawn sand pile with a sandcastle and red-handled shovel at far right and a tiny dot grain.
Left: 'BLACK HOLE MOON' dot 'EVENT HORIZON'; right: 'SAND' label with dot and sand pile with small castle and shovel.
Hard cut to tall dense reference chart (right) with label 'WENTWORTH GRADE SCALE' and curved black arrow pointing at it (left); chart text unreadable at tile scale.
Wentworth grade scale chart with label and arrow; no marks on chart rows.
One-frame pop-on of a red circle around a row in the chart's grain-size column.
Chart with one red circle around a row; view shows chart shifted up slightly relative to G0017 (cropped lower).
One-frame pop-on of a second red circle in the adjacent column beside the first circle.
Chart with two adjacent red circles; label 'WENTWORTH GRADE SCALE' with arrow.

Hard cut to three stacked line-drawn sieves on white; across tiles a tiny dot appears above and the top sieve then middle sieve disappear until one remains then none (sand grain passing through); the last frame (f886) is already a new scene: stick figure with whiteboard diagram (see G0023). Onset of each removal and of the final cut UNRESOLVED.

Left stick figure shrugging with arms out; right framed spacetime diagram: axes 'TIME' and 'DISTANCE FROM BLACK HOLE', dashed 'EVENT HORIZON', wavy 'SINGULARITY', two grey 'FUTURE' cones with tiny stick figures; fine print unreadable.
One-frame pose swap: figure's arms change; figure now holds an hourglass in one hand at right of body; diagram unchanged.
Figure holding hourglass beside the spacetime diagram.
One frame: figure now grips and holds the diagram board tilted (rotated clockwise about 10 degrees) and larger, figure partly cropped at bottom; hourglass gone.
Tilted diagram board held by figure at lower-left; text on diagram rotated.
One-frame swap: board replaced by a crumpled jagged paper ball held against figure's chest on blank canvas.
Blank canvas with stick figure at left holding crumpled paper ball in front of chest.

Cut to split-screen headed 'MOON' (left) and 'BLACK HOLE MOON' (right): grey Earth with faint orbit arc; a grey moon (left) and a tiny black dot (right) travel around Earth over ~100 frames while the Earth and panel divider shift position between tiles (framing change; camera vs object motion UNRESOLVED). Last frame f1161 is a new scene: tiny stick figure with 'F_g' arrow beside a grey sphere labelled 'M'; cut frame UNRESOLVED.
White canvas: small stick figure with 'F_g' and arrow pointing to a grey cratered sphere labelled 'M'.
One-frame swap: grey sphere disappears leaving a tiny dot; labels 'F_g' and 'M' remain.
Stick figure with 'F_g' arrow; tiny dot; label 'M'.
One-frame return of the grey sphere replacing the dot.
Same as G0031: figure 'F_g' arrow, grey sphere 'M'.
Hard cut to large black-outline spiky sun (left), grey Earth with small orbit rings, ghost streak and small grey moon (right).
Outline sun left; Earth with rings and moon right; faint grey orbit line.
One-frame swap: sun drawing replaced by a tiny dot with label 'M_sun'; Earth and moon unchanged.
Tiny dot with 'M_sun' at left; Earth and moon with orbit rings right.

Hard cut to dark rounded plaque on white: starry background, grey-blue Earth with dripping ice, black circle top-right, text 'R.I.P. HUMANS', '200,000 BCE - 2025', and quote 'MAYBE WE SHOULDN'T HAVE TURNED THE SUN INTO A BLACK HOLE'.
R.I.P. HUMANS plaque with Earth, dates and quote.
Hard cut to full-frame night scene: starry sky, glowing moon top-right, two black tree silhouettes, three bats.
Night scene: glowing moon upper right, trees, three bats; dark grey palette.
One frame: moon disappears and small '?' marks appear above each bat and on the left tree.
Night scene without moon; bats and tree with '?' marks.

One frame: trees replaced by a street scene: utility pole and wires, street lamp with grey light cone and red glow, parked car, house with lit window; sky and '?' bats unchanged. Whether treated as cut or overlay UNRESOLVED.
Street at night: pole, lamp light cone, red glow near pole, car, lit house window, bats with '?'.
Hard cut to near-empty dark grey field with sparse stars and one small dark dot with light ring at centre.
Dark field with small ringed dot centre and sparse stars.
One frame: three short white arrows with small spark ticks appear radiating outward around the dot.
Dot with three short outward white arrows with spark marks.
One frame: three long white arrows appear pointing inward toward the dot from upper-left-ish top, right and lower-left.
Dot with three short outward and three long inward white arrows.
One frame: all arrows disappear leaving just the dot on the field.
Dot alone on dark field.
One frame: red-ink sieve drawing upper-left of dot with curved red arrow pointing to the dot.
Red sieve with red arrow to dot on dark field.
Hard cut to near-black diagram: spiral of grey curved strokes (disc) with labels 'PHOTON SPHERE' and 'ISCO', dashed spiral orbit with small sieves along it.
Accretion-spiral diagram with dashed orbit and sieves, labels 'PHOTON SPHERE' and 'ISCO'.
One frame: bright white jet cones (upper and lower) and many small red wavy arrows around the disc appear; diagram slightly rescaled.
Disc with white jets and red wavy outward arrows plus dashed orbit with sieves.
One frame: white label '6% M→E' with curved leader line pointing to the disc appears right of the diagram.
Same diagram with '6% M→E' label and leader.
Hard cut to nearly empty dim grey field with a few tiny star dots and a faint small ring in centre.
Dim field with few dots and faint ring.
One frame: white line drawing of tilted looping orbit ellipses with arrowheads appears near centre-left plus a separate oval at right.
Line drawing of intertwined orbit ellipses with arrowheads; separate oval at right.
Hard cut to starry night with Milky Way band; two grey stick figures standing at bottom (one with hair); glowing moon upper-right.
Starry sky, glowing moon upper-right, two stick figures bottom.
One frame: moon and its glow vanish from sky; figures unchanged.
Starry sky without moon; two figures.
One frame: both figures now wear beanie hats and scarves (heads redrawn).
Starry sky, two stick figures in hats and scarves, no moon.

Hard cut to white chart: y-axis 'TEMPERATURE °C (AVG)' with +0.01/0/-0.01, x-axis 'DAYS AFTER FULL MOON' -7 to 21, moon-phase icons with 'FULL MOON' and 'NEW MOON', grey band; flat line at f2627, then a wavy temperature curve is drawn left-to-right over 6 frames.
Finished temperature curve rising near full moon and falling after; labels FULL MOON NEW MOON.
One frame: cut back to starry night with hatted figures; moon glow returns upper-right crossed out by red scribble hatching.
Starry sky, hatted figures, glowing moon with red scribble.

Cut to dark grey space view: Earth half lit, dashed orbit circle, speech-style left arrow 'SUN: 90 MILLION KILOMILES AWAY!'; small grey moon travels around the orbit over ~150 frames; last frame f3072 is a new scene (whiteboard). Final cut frame UNRESOLVED.
White whiteboard; figure at left writing in red '°C °F K ?'; small cratered moon circle on board.
One frame: red radiating arrows appear around the moon circle; view also shifts slightly.
Moon with red radiating arrows; figure with red '°C °F K ?'.
One frame: three more phase circles appear to the right (half-black, full black, half-black) with red arrows.
Board with four circles: moon, half-black, black, half-black with red arrows.
One frame: label 'LIGHT LEVEL' and four vertical bar meters appear above the circles.
Board with 'LIGHT LEVEL' meters above four circles.

One frame: board shows two dark panels (two blurred moons left; bright white disc right) with captions 'EXAMPLE 1:' and 'EXAMPLE 2:' text unreadable at tile scale; board and figure larger and figure leaning with hand at head.
Board with two dark panels and captions; figure at left.
Hard cut to stacked layout: dark top band with glowing moon and Earth limb, white band below, empty.
Dark top band with moon and Earth curve; white band below; thin divider line.
One frame: sun edge at left, red wavy arrows to a small moon, red 'IR' arrows to Earth appear in the middle band.
Middle band: sun edge, red wavy arrows, moon, 'IR' arrows, Earth; lower band empty.
One frame: red curved arrow with '10X' appears right of Earth.
Middle band with '10X' red arrow top right.
One frame: lower band fills with outline sun, Earth-moon orbit, red '10X' arrow and '±0.01°C'.
Three bands complete: IR diagram with '10X', lower band sun and Earth-moon with '10X ±0.01°C'.
Over 6 frames small red text typed under the upper '10X': '+0.0012°Fahrenheit' (earlier tiny '+' then '+0.0' visible).
Upper '10X' with line '+0.0012°Fahrenheit'.
Over 6 frames second red line typed: '+0.0012° Rankine'.
Two red lines Fahrenheit and Rankine.
Over 5 frames third red line typed: '+0.00035° Rømer'.
Three red lines: Fahrenheit Rankine Rømer.
Over 5 frames fourth red line typed: '+0.00053° Réaumur'.
Four red temperature lines.
Over 5 frames fifth red line typed: '+0.00066 Kelvin'.
Five red unit lines ending '+0.00066 Kelvin' beside upper '10X'.
Hard cut to white graph: y-axis 'TEMPERATURE °C (AVG)' with '+0.001°F', '0', '-0.001°F'; black curve dipping at 'BLACK HOLE MOON' arrow; x-axis 'TIME'.
Graph with black dip curve, 'BLACK HOLE MOON' label and arrow, 'TIME →'.
Over 6 frames a red curve is drawn rising steeply from the dip toward upper right and red label 'CO2 EMISSIONS' is typed beside it.
Graph with black dip then red rising curve labelled 'CO2 EMISSIONS'.
Hard cut to dark scene: grey Moon surface at bottom, lunar lander and tiny astronaut, speech line 'THAT'S ONE SMALL STEP FOR -'.
Astronaut and lander on Moon surface; speech 'THAT'S ONE SMALL STEP FOR -'.
One frame: Moon and lander vanish; astronaut drawn mid-fall with hatched streaks and wavy scream line 'AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!'; first speech line remains.
Falling astronaut with streak lines; 'THAT'S ONE SMALL STEP FOR -' and 'AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!'.
Hard cut to dark space: grey Earth centre, dashed circular orbit, small grey moon at left with ghost marks.
Earth, dashed orbit, grey moon left.
One frame: grey moon replaced by black disc with white glow (black hole); framing shifts slightly.
Earth, dashed orbit, black glowing disc at left.
Over 6 frames red label typed left of black hole: tiny red mark, '600M', then '600M_SUN'.
Earth, dashed orbit, black disc, red '600M_SUN'.
Over 4 frames Earth is sliced to a half disc with debris, then Earth shows cracks with debris and a bright white glowing disc with white jet cones appears at the black hole.
Bright white accretion glow with jets, cracked Earth with debris to its right, '600M_SUN' red.
Over 7 frames view zooms out and pans; objects shrink; Earth is stretched into a white stream flowing to a large bright blob at left. Interpreted as Earth being consumed (INFERRED).
Large white blob upper-left with tail curving to small glowing hole with jets and tiny red label; dashed orbit circle.
Over 5 frames the blob shrinks into a smaller elongated shape with a thin tail.
Small elongated glow with tail; jets at hole.
Over 6 frames everything fades out leaving a small ring dot on dark field.
Small ring dot on dark field.
One frame: white wavy line and text 'BURP!' appear beside the dot.
Dark field with small ring dot and 'BURP!' with wavy line.

Hard cut to red credits card: dinosaur illustration left; 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books' with four book covers; right credit text including 'Randall Munroe', 'Henry Reich', 'Lizah van der Aart', 'Ever Salazar', 'Know Art Studios'.
Red credits card with books and credits; held to end.
